|translation='''Title:''' Mantellian Savrip.

'''Card text:''' Use 3 Force to deploy on your side of the table, or deploy for 0 if [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)|C-3PO]] is on the table. When you lose a battle, you may forfeit character, starship, or vehicle cards from your hand at their printed forfeit values to reduce battle damage or attrition.

'''Lore:''' Dejarik is a game played with holograms of fierce animals and legendary monsters from across the galaxy. The [[Mantellian Savrip|Mantellian Savrip]] is a ferocious carnivore from Ord Mantell.
